_about.license: Original art generated for Brian Awsumb's Last Stand Tower; no third-party or licensed art, no copyrighted references. Style reference: Brian's own enemy sprites (assets/sprites/enemies/tank, basic).
_about.noCodeArt: No shapes, gradients, rings, glows, tints, recolours, hue shifts or outline changes are drawn or applied by code. Code only removes the background, cuts/centres/scales frames and (chain_bolt only) applies opacity steps for fade frames.

chain_arc_flash/chain_arc_flash.png.prompt: Mobile game effect sprite sheet in the flat cartoon style of the reference characters (use the reference ONLY for its line and colour style; do not draw the characters). 2 columns x 2 rows of 4 equal square cells on a flat solid royal blue background (#1a3cff), no grid lines. A one-shot electric spark ring that pops on a struck enemy, centred in each cell, read left to right then top to bottom: frame 1 a small tight ring of short yellow spark zig-zags snapping on; frame 2 a full round ring of jagged yellow electric zig-zags with little four-point star sparks; frame 3 the ring breaking apart outward into separate spark bits; frame 4 a few small spark bits fading out. The centre of the ring stays empty in every frame. Colours: bright yellow (#ffe14d) and golden yellow (#ffc61a) with a thick dark purple-navy ink outline (#2b1d3a) on every spark. Yellow, NOT white: no white flash, no white core. Nothing touches the cell edges. Flat cartoon vector, no text.
cleanup: flat key-colour background removal (_tools/keying.py: border-median key, smoothstep alpha, enclosed key pockets, speck drop, key un-mix + edge bleed)
frame cut: connected components assigned to their grid cell
registration: each frame centred on its alpha bbox centre (chain_arc_flash: on the main ring component)
one common uniform downscale per asset (premultiplied LANCZOS), so relative frame sizes from the raw are kept

chain_bolt/chain_bolt.png.prompt: Mobile game effect sprites in the flat cartoon style of the reference characters (use the reference ONLY for its line and colour style; do not draw the characters). Three separate horizontal cartoon lightning bolt segments stacked one above another on a flat solid magenta background (#ff00ff), with wide empty magenta gaps between them. Each bolt is a long thin jagged zig-zag electric line running straight from the far left edge to the far right edge of the image, chunky bright yellow (#ffe14d) with a slightly lighter yellow core stripe (#fff27a), wrapped in a thick dark purple-navy ink underlay outline (#2b1d3a). Bolt 1 (top): a few large zig-zags. Bolt 2 (middle): many small sharp zig-zags. Bolt 3 (bottom): medium zig-zags with one small forked spur. Each bolt is thin, its height about one eighth of its length. Flat cartoon vector, no white, no glow haze, no sparkles, no text.
cleanup: flat key-colour background removal (_tools/keying.py: border-median key, smoothstep alpha, enclosed key pockets, speck drop, key un-mix + edge bleed)

each bolt band cropped to its own bbox, uniform downscale so it spans exactly 256 px (x=0..255), centred vertically in the 48 px frame (bolt about 21-23 px tall; no vertical stretch, so the ink is not thickened)
fade frames = opacity steps of the same painted bolt: alpha x1.0, x0.6, x0.25
layout rows = variants (top/middle/bottom bolt of the raw), cols = fade frames

chain_node_glow/chain_node_glow.png.prompt: Game VFX sprite: a single soft round glowing bloom of light, centered, on a pure flat black background (#000000). The bloom is a smooth soft radial glow of pure saturated electric yellow (#ffe14d), like the soft glow under a lightning spark. Its core in the middle is a denser, more intense deep saturated yellow (#ffd400) - never white: no white centre, no white highlight, no pale or pastel tones anywhere. The glow fades smoothly and evenly to completely black, reaching pure black well before the image edges; the whole glow sits inside the central 60% of the image. No outline, no ring, no rays, no lens flare, no sparkles, no stars, no texture, no text, nothing else.
cleanup: black-background removal: alpha = (max(R,G,B)-6)/249, colour un-mixed from black (rgb/alpha); hue untouched
square window centred on the glow centroid, half-size = 1.08 x radius where mean alpha drops below 1%
uniform downscale (premultiplied LANCZOS)
